SELECT f.channel_code, s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.gross_amount END) staff_gross, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, s.format, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.open_date, s.close_date, f.channel_code, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1 AND false))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,9

SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' k, count(*) n FROM (SELECT receipt_id,line_no,count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING c>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'gross_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02
UNION ALL SELECT 'null_gross', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND (gross_amount IS NULL OR net_amount IS NULL)
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_qty', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND (quantity<=0 OR net_amount<0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'chan_mismatch', count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND ((channel_code='WB') <> (channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM dim_channel WHERE channel_group='web')))
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap', count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30'

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) net_nostaff, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.channel_code='ST' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, count(DISTINCT store_id) rstores FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT strftime(coalesce(w.sale_date,r.business_date),'%Y-%m') m, count(*) days, sum(net_all) net_all, sum(net_nostaff) nostaff, sum(nsbr) rpt, sum(CASE WHEN w.sale_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_missing_fact, sum(CASE WHEN r.business_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) days_missing_rpt, min(stores), max(stores), min(rstores), max(rstores)
FROM w FULL JOIN r ON w.sale_date=r.business_date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) net_all, sum(CASE WHEN NOT f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) nostaff, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<>900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-31' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT store_id, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(receipts) rcp FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-31' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT coalesce(w.store_id,r.store_id) sid, net_all, nostaff, nsbr, round(nsbr-net_all,2) d_all, rc, rcp
FROM w FULL JOIN r ON w.store_id=r.store_id WHERE w.store_id IS NULL OR r.store_id IS NULL OR abs(nsbr-net_all)>0.01 ORDER BY 1
